Questions.content: What is the significance of the task "CalculateRemainingAfterRentAndFuel" if it does not depend on any other task and can be calculated directly from the initial salary after the "CalculateRent" and "CalculateFuel" tasks? This task seems unnecessary given the current order.

Answers.content:
The task "CalculateRemainingAfterRentAndFuel" can indeed be calculated directly from the initial salary after performing the tasks "CalculateRent" and "CalculateFuel". Since it does not depend on any other task in the current order, it is redundant. The remaining amount after rent and fuel expenses can be computed as follows:

1. Calculate rent: \( \text{rent} = \frac{1}{4} \times \text{salary} \)
2. Calculate car fuel: \( \text{fuel} = \frac{1}{3} \times \text{salary} \)
3. Subtract these from the initial salary to get the remaining amount after rent and fuel: 
   \[
   \text{remaining\_after\_rent\_and\_fuel} = \text{salary} - \text{rent} - \text{fuel}
   \]

This calculation can be directly performed in the "CalculateRemainingAfterRentAndFuel" task without needing a separate task for it. Therefore, this task is unnecessary and can be removed from the TG to simplify the process.
